title: Especialista jurídico
description:
Vaga afirmativa para PCD e 40+

Especialista Jurídico

Qualidade para Vida - Esta é a visão de negócio da GMReis, que há mais de 25 anos desenvolve, produz e comercializa sua linha de produtos, classificada em próteses ortopédicas.

A inovação tecnológica aliada à qualidade dos produtos são os valores buscados diariamente na GMReis para que a expectativa dos clientes, médicos e pacientes, seja plenamente atendida com segurança e eficácia.

A GMReis está sediada em Campinas/SP em uma área de 6.000 m², dentro de um moderno parque tecnológico, com equipamentos de produção e análise metrológica de última geração, e uma área limpa ISO classe 8 de 800 m² onde são fabricados enxertos ósseos e implantes biorreabsorvíveis.

Atuação Presencial

Horário: Segunda a Quinta 07:30h as 17:30 e sexta 07:30h as 16:30h.

Área: Jurídico

Reporte: CEO

Regime: CLT

Descrição do Cargo

Atuar como Especialista Jurídico, prestando apoio técnico direto ao CEO, com foco na leitura, análise e revisão de contratos empresariais, inclusive em língua inglesa, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e suporte à tomada de decisão da Diretoria.

Atuar como ponto focal jurídico da empresa, realizando análises jurídicas preliminares e intermediando, de forma técnica, as demandas junto a escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas.

Principais Atividades:

  • Ler, analisar e revisar contratos empresariais, inclusive contratos redigidos em inglês, identificando riscos, inconsistências e pontos de atenção;
  • Prestar suporte jurídico direto ao CEO em temas contratuais e decisões estratégicas;
  • Atuar como interface técnica junto a escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas, alinhando escopo, análises e encaminhamentos;
  • Realizar análises jurídicas preliminares nas áreas contratual, societária, tributária e trabalhista, direcionando demandas às consultorias especializadas quando necessário;
  • Acompanhar prazos, vigências, renovações e aditivos contratuais, avaliando impactos jurídicos e financeiros;
  • Contribuir para a padronização de instrumentos contratuais, em conjunto com o jurídico externo;
  • Garantir controle, organização e rastreabilidade dos contratos e demandas jurídicas da empresa;
  • Apoiar áreas internas em temas jurídicos, conforme diretrizes da Diretoria.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Direito;
  • OAB ativa;
  • Experiência prática com contratos empresariais;
  • Capacidade comprovada de leitura, interpretação e análise de contratos em inglês;
  • Vivência em interface com escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas;
  • Perfil técnico, analítico e criterioso;
  • Discrição, ética profissional e capacidade de atuação próxima à alta liderança.
  • Residir em Campinas ou Sumaré, Paulínia, Hortolândia ou Valinhos.

Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível
  • Convênio médico coparticipativo (para o colaborador (a)
  • Convênio odontológico para colaborador e dependentes
  • Parceria com a faculdade Esamc descontos de até 50% na mensalidade para graduações e tecnólogos e 20% para MBA.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.
  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.
  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.
  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.

Required Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.

  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).
  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

title: Manager - Investment Analysis & Financial Modelling
description:
About CELA

CELA – Clean Energy Latin America is a leading financial and strategic advisory firm focused on energy transition in Latin America.

  • For over 13 years, we have advised companies and investors in:
  • Strategic and market advisory
  • Fundraising and project finance
  • Financial structuring
  • Mergers & acquisitions

We work across solar, wind, energy storage, and green hydrogen, supporting key stakeholders shaping the region’s energy transition.

Learn more:

The Role

We are seeking a Manager – Investment Analysis & Financial Modelling to lead financial modelling initiatives and support high-impact projects in the energy transition sector.

This is a senior role combining:

  • Advanced financial modelling
  • Investment and valuation expertise
  • Project leadership
  • Client interaction
  • Team development

You will play a key role in structuring analyses, reviewing models, and ensuring technical excellence across engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Lead the development and review of complex financial models for:
  • Valuation exercises
  • Financial restructuring
  • Oversee financial feasibility analyses and investment memoranda
  • Ensure robustness, consistency, and auditability of financial models

Strategic & Investment Analysis

  • Analyze operational and regulatory assumptions in energy projects
  • Evaluate key financial metrics (EV, NPV, IRR, Payback, DSCR, leverage ratios)
  • Contribute to strategic decision-making alongside senior leadership

Team & Client Management

  • Supervise and mentor analysts and consultants
  • Review deliverables and provide technical guidance
  • Lead or actively participate in client meetings and investor discussions
  • Manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously

Profile

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
  • Structured communicator, able to present complex financial analyses clearly to clients and investors
  • High level of ownership and accountability
  • Comfortable leading teams in a dynamic advisory environment
  • Motivated by the energy transition and impact-driven work

Requirements

7+ years of experience in:

  • Investment analysis
  • Financial modelling
  • Corporate finance
  • Project finance
  • M&A or transaction advisory

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Accounting, or related fields

Advanced Excel skills (mandatory)

Fluent English (mandatory)

Proven experience managing projects and/or junior team members

Full-time availability with exclusivity

Availability to work primarily remote (home office)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, or power sector projects
  • Experience in investment banking, consulting, infrastructure funds, or energy developers
  • Knowledge of Power BI or financial automation tools
  • Postgraduate degree (MBA, Master’s in Finance, Energy, or related field)

Compensation

  • Competitive and market-aligned compensation
  • Compensation package negotiable based on experience and track record
  • Performance-based growth potential

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Who we are

We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!

Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.

You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.

About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.

You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the Opportunity:

Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.

You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.
  • Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.
  • Make cold calls when necessary.
  • Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.
  • Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).
  • Partner closely with Account Executives.

Requirements

  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.
  • Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.
  • Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).
  • Background in consulting or IT services companies.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end
description:
VAGA — DESENVOLVEDOR FRONTEND (PLENO / SÊNIOR)

Empresa: Atman Systems

FAIXA SALARIAL

R$ 4.500 a R$ 9.000

Enquadramento conforme avaliação técnica.

SOBRE A VAGA

Vaga para desenvolvimento frontend com foco em interfaces web para produtos digitais, integração com APIs complexas, dados em tempo real e visualização de grandes volumes de dados.

Atuação em aplicações que envolvem WebSockets, mapas, geolocalização e camadas GIS, interfaces operacionais 24/7, controle de acesso por perfil e restrições de latência e performance em sistemas críticos e orientados a funcionamento contínuo.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web complexas
  • Implementação de interfaces que consomem APIs REST e comunicação em tempo real
  • Integração com dados ao vivo, mapas e dispositivos
  • Construção de dashboards operacionais e visualizações de dados
  • Atuação em sistemas com restrições de latência e performance
  • Implementação de controle de acesso, perfis e autenticação
  • Otimização de renderização, estado e carregamento de dados
  • Garantia de estabilidade, usabilidade e confiabilidade em produção
  • Atuação conjunta com times de backend, hardware e produto

STACK E CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS (OBRIGATÓRIOS)

  • Angular 2+
  • TypeScript e JavaScript
  • HTML5 e CSS3
  • Docker
  • Consumo de APIs REST e WebSockets
  • Domínio de estado complexo e dados em tempo real
  • Conceitos de performance frontend e otimização
  • Versionamento com Git
  • Integração com sistemas de autenticação e controle de acesso

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com desenvolvimento frontend
  • Inglês intermediário à avançado
  • Graduação em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Espanhol ou italiano em nível conversacional será considerado um grande diferencial.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de mapas.
  • Vivência com sistemas críticos, operacionais ou 24/7.
  • Experiência com aplicações de alto volume de dados.

PERFIL TÉCNICO ESPERADO

  • Perfil analítico
  • Capacidade técnica elevada
  • Interesse real em resolver problemas complexos.
  • Atenção a performance, estabilidade e impacto em produção.

REGIME DE CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

Regime de contratação: CLT Presencial

Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Plano de saúde Unimed
  • Plano odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Plano de carreira estruturado

CANDIDATURA

Os interessados devem enviar currículo para o e-mail , informando no assunto a área de interesse.

title: Professor de química
description:
Sobre Nós

Somos a Rede ICM de Educação e Assistência Social que, fiel às suas origens, acolhe e educa crianças, adolescentes e jovens, garantindo um processo formativo integral e inovador, que possibilita o desenvolvimento do senso crítico, da ética, da solidariedade e da cidadania. As unidades de ensino e socioassistenciais, em seu fazer educativo, favorecem a construção do conhecimento e do desenvolvimento humano, científico, tecnológico e espiritual; contribuem para a formação de cidadãos capazes de analisar, compreender, posicionar-se e intervir na realidade, promovendo transformações sociais, com vistas ao bem estar da pessoa, no plano pessoal e coletivo.

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos buscando um profissional da área de docência da disciplina de química para nossa unidade educacional, o Colégio Madre Bárbara, localizado no bairro Centro de Lajeado/RS, podendo ser moradores dos arredores: Venâncio Aires, Estrela, Arroio do Meio e etc.

Posição : Professor(a) de Química

Modalidade : Efetivo - CLT

Atribuições :

  • Responsável por atuar na educação de alunos do 9° ano do fundamental ao ensino médio, por meio da organização, planejamento e execução de atividades, bem como pelo cumprimento dos procedimentos e rotinas vinculados ao Projeto Educativo.

Jornada Semanal :

  • A carga horária é de 24h semanais, dias da semana a serem combinados (horário das aulas das 7h30min às 12h e das 13h30min às 18h).

Requisitos :

  • Licenciatura em Química, desejável especialização na área.
  • Ter atuado em escolas particulares será um diferencial.

Oferecemos:

  • Remuneração compatível com a função + VT, Plano de Saúde Unimed com coparticipação, desconto na mensalidade de filhos matriculados no Colégio e plano de aprimoramento acadêmico conforme acordo coletivo (após a conclusão de cada etapa de instrução é adicionado o valor sobre a remuneração sendo 5% na realização de Pós Graduação, 10% em Mestrado e 15% em Doutorado).
company: Rede ICM de Educação e Assistência Social

title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:
About You

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. You thrive in structured environments, value best practices, and take ownership of delivering reliable, well-documented systems. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and feel comfortable supporting, maintaining, and evolving complex business applications.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (mandatory and up to date, with annual renewal).
  • Strong experience developing and customizing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) solutions.
  • Solid understanding of D365 F&O architecture, development lifecycle, and best practices.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations using Azure Data Factory for ETL and data synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience using Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and maintenance.
  • Ability to collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for production and non-production environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications based on business requirements.
  • Design, build, and support data integrations using Azure Data Factory, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
  • Use Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) to manage deployments, monitor environments, and support application health.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional consultants, developers, business users) to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for D365 F&O applications.
  • Document technical designs, configurations, integrations, and operational processes.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of D365 F&O solutions.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: SQL Architect

Location : Remote

15+ years of IT experience and minimum of 10+ years using public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL IaaS/PaaS, Azure Storage , Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM

Primary skills:

  • Demonstrates a high level of proficiency and hands-on expertise in delivering high quality designs using Architecture frameworks
  • Conducting AS-IS assessments of applications, designing target state architecture, and obtaining approvals from client architecture review board.
  • Expertise in On-prem/Public cloud Infra assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Driving the cloud Solutioning Azure activities for large complex migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering Business, Application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Working experience with various industry domains like banking, healthcare, Insurance
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design and build Azure Landing Zone activities
  • Provide the Azure target architecture and its BoM pricing and licensing related details
  • Azure Target Solutions architect Diagram (all Azure services) including HLD & LLD
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure & Windows environments (Processor, networking, clusters, IO, memory etc. related issues)

Secondary Skills:

  • Design infrastructure/Data storage solutions
  • Design business continuity/DR solutions
  • Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $8,500 - $10,000 USD

The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure role is designed to own the technical systems responsible for money movement across their organization. At our partner, payments are not a support function. They are core product infrastructure. They advance funds to lab clients based on AI-driven claim valuation, reconcile against real insurance adjudication data, and manage complex settlement flows that must balance to the penny.

As transaction volume scales into hundreds of millions annually, the complexity of reliability, reconciliation, auditability, and compliance increases materially. This role exists to ensure they scale financial infrastructure with rigor, precision, and long-term architectural clarity. This is a player-coach leadership role, initially hands-on, evolving into team leadership and architectural stewardship of a dedicated payments engineering pod.

This role is accountable for:

  • Technical ownership of payment infrastructure and settlement systems
  • Reliability and correctness of all financial flows
  • Ledger and reconciliation architecture
  • Cross-team coordination for finance-critical systems
  • Building and leading a dedicated payments engineering pod

Key Responsibilities:

Payment Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own systems that disburse client advances, execute Treasury sweeps, process lockbox deposits, and generate settlement payments
  • Ensure all transactions reconcile precisely and remain fully auditable
  • Implement idempotency, monitoring, alerting, retry logic, and failure handling for payment-critical flows
  • Design workflows resilient to bank outages, ACH return codes, NSF events, and timing mismatches
  • Establish zero-error tolerance standards as volume scales

Ledger & Reconciliation Architecture

  • Design and evolve the internal ledger system tracking each receivable lifecycle from claim valuation to advance to adjudication to sweep to final settlement
  • Build reconciliation engines matching Payment Advances to ERA data
  • Automate weekly settlement calculations, including true-ups, clawbacks, and offsets
  • Ensure economic logic for Qualified vs. Non-Qualified claims is correctly implemented
  • Maintain strict auditability and financial traceability across systems

Cross-Team Collaboration & Platform Integration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Data, Billing, and Clinical Platform teams
  • Ensure payment systems integrate cleanly with claim processing, ERA ingestion, and AI valuation systems
  • Partner with the Data team on financial reporting, reconciliation validation, and KPI consistency
  • Align with shared infrastructure standards including observability, deployment, security, and API governance
  • Actively participate in architecture discussions to prevent payment systems from becoming isolated silos

Payment infrastructure must operate as part of the broader platform, not adjacent to it.

Banking & Financial Partner Integration

  • Own integrations with banking partners and payment rails including ACH, EFT, and lockbox flows
  • Ensure client onboarding for Treasury Accounts and payment configuration is scalable and repeatable
  • Evaluate and integrate banking-as-a-service platforms and financial data providers
  • Maintain compliance with NACHA rules, treasury controls, and internal financial policies

Team Leadership & Engineering Standards

  • Hire and build a payments-focused engineering pod consisting of 2 to 3 engineers within 12 to 18 months
  • Define engineering standards for reliability, testing, deployment, and incident response
  • Establish operational playbooks for payment-critical systems
  • Partner closely with Payment Operations to ensure systems support real-world workflows
  • Balance hands-on contribution with leadership and long-term architectural planning

What This Role Is Not:

  • Not a purely operational finance role
  • Not a detached architecture-only leadership position
  • Not a payments API integration wrapper role

This is a systems-level ownership role where financial correctness, reliability, and architectural clarity are primary responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like:

  • All money movement is reliable, traceable, and auditable
  • Settlement logic is automated and predictable
  • Reconciliation discrepancies are rare and surfaced early
  • Banking integrations are standardized and repeatable
  • Payment-critical incidents decrease over time
  • Cross-team dependencies are clear and well-managed
  • A high-performing payments pod operates with strong engineering discipline

Ideal Background:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • 3+ years building payment systems, financial infrastructure, or money movement platforms
  • Deep knowledge of ACH including NACHA rules, R-codes, batch construction, and prefunding
  • Experience designing ledger systems or reconciliation engines
  • Strong backend engineering experience including Python, Go, Java, or similar
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience operating payment-critical systems in production
  • Prior experience hiring or leading small engineering teams
  • Prior experience working at Nubank or in similar fintech companies

Strengths We Value:

  • Precision and rigor in financial system design
  • Systems thinking across multi-party money flows
  • Strong reliability mindset including observability, incident response, and recovery design
  • Clear, structured communication across engineering and finance stakeholders
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity while building durable architecture
  • High ownership and accountability

Why This Role Matters:

At our partner, money movement is core infrastructure, not an auxiliary capability.

Every advance, sweep, settlement, and reconciliation must be correct. As they scale into

hundreds of millions in annual volume, small architectural weaknesses compound into material financial risk.

This role ensures:

  • They scale financial infrastructure responsibly
  • They maintain trust with lab clients and banking partners
  • They prevent operational fragility as complexity grows
  • They build a durable foundation for future financial products

The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure will help ensure that as they grow, their financial systems remain precise, resilient, and strategically aligned with the broader platform.

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Arquiteto de soluções Azure (Banco de talentos)

  • Vivência e entendimento de portfólios de aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte, incluindo migração de workloads locais para a nuvem;
  • Experiência técnica em larga escala com hospedagem de aplicações nativas em nuvem, design, desenvolvimento, implantação e refatoração/migração de aplicações;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de servidores web, design de aplicações em nuvem, arquitetura de software e práticas como Agile, SCRUM e DevOps;

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens exporaticas)

title: Atendente de E commerce (L1) - Marketplaces
description:
Local: Presencial - Região da Paulista

Regime: CLT

Horário: Comercial - 5x2

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Atendente de E‑commerce (Nível 1) para atuar diretamente no atendimento aos clientes em marketplaces como Shopee, Mercado Livre, TikTok Shop e outros canais digitais .

Este profissional será responsável por garantir uma experiência positiva ao cliente, oferecendo suporte eficiente, cordial e alinhado às políticas da empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Atender clientes via chat, e-mail e mensagens nos principais marketplaces.
  • Responder dúvidas gerais: produtos, prazos, formas de envio, políticas e status do pedido.
  • Auxiliar clientes na criação, acompanhamento, cancelamento e atualização de pedidos.
  • Tratar solicitações de troca, devolução e reembolso.
  • Registrar interações no sistema seguindo scripts e procedimentos internos.
  • Monitorar e responder avaliações e mensagens em todas as plataformas.
  • Identificar e relatar problemas recorrentes, como divergências de pedido, atrasos logísticos ou itens danificados, escalando corretamente para o time L2/Operações.
  • Apresentar promoções, campanhas e oportunidades ao cliente.
  • Encaminhar solicitações que exigem análise profunda para as equipes responsáveis.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência prévia com e-commerce ou atendimento ao cliente é desejável.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em Português.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e com múltiplos atendimentos simultâneos.
  • Organização, foco e agilidade.
  • Inglês é um diferencial.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência com Shopee, Mercado Livre ou TikTok Shop.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, OMS ou ERPs.
  • Conhecimento básico de logística e políticas de marketplaces.

Benefícios

  • Vale‑refeição
  • Vale‑transporte
  • Plano de saúde (conforme política interna).
  • Plano odontológico (opcional).

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Somos uma empresa em crescimento, com forte presença em marketplaces e foco na qualidade da experiência do cliente.

Valorizamos pessoas comprometidas, comunicativas e com vontade de evoluir profissionalmente no universo do e-commerce.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack (JavaScript, React, Node.js)
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Typescript | React | Node

Modelo de contratação: PJ (sem benefícios)

Trabalho: 100% remoto

⏱ Dedicação: Fulltime

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Frontend (React/Next.js)

  • Desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas com forte integração de APIs
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando hooks nativos do React (useState, useEffect, useContext, useCallback, useMemo)
  • Gerenciar estado global com Zustand
  • Trabalhar com TanStack Query para consumo eficiente de APIs
  • Utilizar shadcn/ui e Tailwind CSS para componentes

Backend (Node.js/Fastify)

  • Construir e manter APIs RESTful
  • Trabalhar com Drizzle ORM e PostgreSQL
  • Integrar serviços externos (Buckets, RabbitMQ)
Stack Tecnológica

Frontend

  • Next.js + React
  • TypeScript
  • Zustand (gerenciamento de estado)
  • TanStack Query
  • shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Node.js + TypeScript
  • Fastify
  • Drizzle ORM
  • PostgreSQL
  • RabbitMQ
  • Integração com Buckets/Storage
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de React (hooks, contexts, gerenciamento de estado)
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs REST
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL)
Diferenciais
  • Docker
  • Python (manipulação de arquivos)
  • Experiência com message brokers (RabbitMQ)

title: Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 58034

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Kubernetes, AWS, e .NET CORE , além de experiência em Arquitetura de Software, SOLID, Clean Code e práticas avançadas de Code Review .
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • 100% remoto.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: TIBCO EBX Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Java development, ideally applied within TIBCO EBX extensions or customizations;
  • Hands‑on experience developing on TIBCO EBX (data modeling, workflows, services, UI configuration, data quality rules);
  • Understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) processes and governance, especially in EBX contexts;
  • English B2;
  • Must relocate to Portugal.

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal and in here will be 2x on-site.

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send apply!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Portuguese Teacher
description:
At Qubika, we design, develop, and deploy custom software solutions for organizations that are making an impact through technology.

We are currently looking for a Portuguese Teacher based in Brazil to join our In-House Teacher Team and support our professionals in their language development journey.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about teaching adults in corporate environments, who enjoys creating dynamic and goal-oriented virtual classes.

What we expect from you:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience teaching Portuguese to adults or foreign learners
  • Teaching certification (Language Teaching or Foreign Language Teaching). If you have +3 years of experience in language institutes, certification is a plus but not mandatory
  • Experience teaching in corporate or professional contexts
  • Ability to plan objective-based lessons and adapt them to different proficiency levels
  • Experience working with CEFR levels (A1–C1/C2)
  • Strong experience with online teaching tools (Zoom, Google Meet, shared docs, presentations, digital whiteboards, etc.)
  • Experience assessing and tracking student progress
  • Strong asynchronous communication skills (Slack, email, other platforms)
  • Excellent time management and punctuality in virtual classes
  • High level of autonomy and organization

What we offer

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong focus on GoLang to join a cross-functional, solution-driven development team. You will play a key role in building new products, developing integrations, and continuously evolving our platform. If you enjoy building scalable services, writing clean and high-quality code, and working in a collaborative, impact-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate within a cross-functional team to design and deliver product-driven solutions;
  • Develop and implement new features, products, and platform integrations;
  • Build scalable, resilient web services and APIs using GoLang;
  • Maintain high-quality standards through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices;
  • Identify and fix bugs while monitoring and optimizing application performance;
  • Contribute to aligning technical strategy with business objectives;
  • Produce clear and well-structured technical documentation;
  • Embody the team's values: ownership, innovation, collaboration, and customer empathy.

Technical Requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience;
  • Strong hands-on experience with GoLang for backend development;
  • Experience building scalable and fault-tolerant web services and APIs;
  • Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases;
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services;
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Concourse or similar);
  • Strong understanding of clean, testable, and maintainable code principles;
  • Experience with automated testing (unit and/or integration tests);
  • Strong communication skills to understand requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions;
  • Growth mindset: commitment to continuous improvement, proactive attitude, and strong sense of ownership.

What to Expect in the Day-to-Day

The role involves a balanced mix of:

  • New feature implementation;
  • Testing and validation;
  • Bug fixing and performance improvements;
  • Technical documentation.

Come and join the BEST IT TEAM!

title: Executivo(a) de Contas
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Executivo(a) de Contas Sênior – Remoto

Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Executivo(a) de Contas . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!

Requisitos essenciais:

  • Disponibilidade para idas pontuais ao escritório e visitas a clientes, caso seja do RJ ou SP;
  • Experiência no setor de Utilities & Energia ;
  • Sólida experiência em vendas diretas consultivas, com histórico comprovado na prospecção de novos clientes e no posicionamento de ofertas de transformação digital;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações, desenvolvimento de software, automação de processos, serviços de AMS (Application Management Services), alocação de profissionais e licenciamento de software;
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas de serviços de TI, com histórico consistente de abertura de novos clientes e sólida atuação na gestão de contas da base instalada, com foco em relacionamento, crescimento e superação de metas;
  • Perfil hunter, com mentalidade empreendedora, alta energia e resiliência;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação executiva e negociação em contas enterprise;
  • Conhecimento prático sobre propostas de valor em transformação digital, abrangendo projetos, AMS, sustentação, alocação de profissionais e licenciamento de software;
  • Experiência no uso de CRM (preferencialmente Microsoft Dynamics) para gestão de pipeline, forecast e controle de vendas;
  • Habilidade em storytelling e construção de business cases;
  • Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado desejável, para atuação em oportunidades com fabricantes e parceiros.

Requisitos adicionais:

  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar novas contas, identificando e acessando decisores em empresas enterprise por meio de abordagem consultiva e rede de relacionamentos;
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas, desde o primeiro contato até a negociação final e fechamento do contrato;
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com executivos de negócios e tecnologia, atuando como parceiro de transformação digital;
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas de valor, business cases e apresentações executivas personalizadas às necessidades do cliente;
  • Conduzir negociações com foco em geração de valor, margem e sustentabilidade do relacionamento;
  • Coordenar a transição para as equipes de entrega, garantindo o onboarding adequado de novos clientes;
  • Atualizar e gerenciar o pipeline no CRM, mantendo dados de oportunidades, previsões e atividades de vendas;
  • Monitorar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e propondo estratégias de diferenciação para a Sys Manager;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de pré-vendas, marketing e Centros de Excelência (CoEs) na estruturação de propostas competitivas e de alto valor.

Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Auxílio Creche;

Assistência Médica;

description:
Sobre a vaga

Código da vaga: 58331

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Principais responsabilidades

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com .NET
  • Experiência prática em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3)
  • Experiência com Mensageria (RabbitMQ ou similares)
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL
  • Domínio em Microsserviços
  • Experiência com Metodologias Ágeis, CI/CD e controle de versão com Git.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de altíssimo tráfego e escalabilidade.

Modelo de atuação

  • 100% remoto.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the planning and execution of core consumer experience initiatives, ensuring projects move seamlessly from concept to launch on mobile platforms.
  • Manage the workflow for A/B testing and feature rollouts, ensuring that data, engineering, and design teams are coordinated to deliver insights rapidly.
  • Manage trade-offs effectively to deliver measurable business impact without sacrificing technical quality or team health.
  • Use project metrics to identify bottlenecks in the development lifecycle and continuously improve how we build and scale.

Qualifications

  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Proven experience managing the delivery of mobile products (iOS/Android), with a solid understanding of app release cycles and store submission processes.

  • Strong command of Agile/Scrum methodologies, specifically adapted for teams that run frequent A/B tests and iterative loops.
  • Deep intuition for resource allocation—knowing how to organize backlogs and schedules to support both immediate business objectives and long-term improvements.

title: Partner Lead - Creator & IRL Business
description:
The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).

About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.

Role Overview

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.

What You'll Do

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams

Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution
  • Clear pipeline and local momentum
  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU

Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on
  • Strong network in media, creators, streaming, or tech
  • Comfortable owning revenue outcomes
  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments

Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy
  • Be part of a fast-paced, fast-growing Silicon Valley company with 300+ team members worldwide
  • Work at the center of the rapidly evolving creator economy
  • You’ll help shape how the next generation of live creators operates, with real ownership, global visibility, and direct impact on growth

Please note that your application will only be considered if your CV and email are sent directly to:  

TVU Networks is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage those who meet the qualifications to apply.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

title: Supervisor(a) de manutenção - Belém/PA
description:

  • Distribuir os serviços de manutenção entre a equipe, especificar peças para possíveis manutenções, contactar técnicos da fornecedora de produtos, treinar e desenvolver os colaboradores, desenvolvendo cultura ambiental e em segurança do trabalho;

  • Prestar a rígida observância, seguindo às normas e procedimentos de qualidade, segurança, saúde, meio ambiente, diretrizes de compliance, anticorrupção e antissuborno, responsabilidade social e sustentabilidade da empresa, conforme compromisso com as Políticas e com o Código de Conduta da empresa.

title: Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No cargo de Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente, você será responsável por fornecer assistência eficiente aos clientes, garantindo a resolução de dúvidas e problemas relacionados aos produtos e serviços da empresa. Você deverá dominar as ferramentas e sistemas comercializados, acompanhar todas as atualizações e aplicar seus conhecimentos em informática para orientar os usuários em tarefas como a inserção de novos usuários, criação de categorias e navegação pelos menus do sistema.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar o atendimento de clientes dos serviços da empresa via telefone, e-mail, chat ou videoconferência;
  • Manter os clientes informados sobre mudanças no serviço, tendências e oportunidades;
  • Registrar demandas, pedidos de suporte e sugestões repassadas pelos usuários;
  • Auxiliar os usuários na resolução de problemas de baixa complexidade;
  • Efetuar a triagem de problemas, e garantir correto encaminhamento das demandas para demais responsáveis e áreas da empresa, quando necessário;
  • Auxiliar no teste de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e pilotos;
  • Registrar tickets de inconsistências e sugestões na ferramenta de gestão de projetos;
  • Incrementar o FAQ de atendimento ao cliente, à medida que novas perguntas e respostas surgem;
  • Gravação de tutoriais.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação em andamento ou concluída em Psicologia, Administração, Comunicação, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência com atendimento ao cliente, atendimento por ligações e videochamadas.
  • Conhecimento técnico intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Expressar-se de forma clara e sucinta;
  • Empatia, carisma e postura cordial;
  • Ser paciente e proativo.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.

What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.

What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.

What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Email Graphic Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design
  • Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations
  • Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience
  • Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members

Responsibilities

  • Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines
  • Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices
  • Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life
  • Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results
  • Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account
  • Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production
  • Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices
  • Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations
  • Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches
  • Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards
  • Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems
  • Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy
  • Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality
  • Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)
  • Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement
  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement

Compensation And Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Assegurar que todas as atividades e operações sejam realizadas de forma segura, em conformidade com os regulamentos e a legislação que regem as operações de negócios.
  • Identificar escopo, premissas, restrições e requisitos técnicos do projeto.
  • Elaborar o plano do projeto, garantindo integração entre escopo, custos, receita, recursos e prazos.
  • Identificar e analisar quantitativa e qualitativamente os riscos do projeto, criando planos de respostas e realizando também seu monitoramento.
  • Controlar mudanças e seus impactos.
  • Conduzir reuniões/apresentações sobre o projeto com clientes e equipe.
  • Coletar, distribuir e aplicar lições aprendidas.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com o cliente identificando oportunidades.
  • Aplicar as diretrizes de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Gerenciar o contrato e garantir que as ações estejam alinhadas com as questões contratuais, incluindo licenças, seguros, garantias bancárias e faturas aos clientes.
  • Realizar controle financeiro, realizado e forecast, para custos e receitas.
  • Garantir o faturamento e recebimento prontamente conforme contrato.
  • Liderar e motivar a equipe do projeto com o objetivo de atingir a produtividade ideal contribuindo para o sucesso do projeto.
  • Participar ativamente e promover melhorias no sistema de QSSMS da
  • empresa.
  • Realizar visitas às frentes operacionais, exercendo seu papel de liderança visível.
  • Garantir a eficiência na execução do projeto de acordo com o requerimento contratual (escopo, cronograma e custo/receita).
  • Garantir a comunicação eficiente entre os envolvidos (cliente, fornecedor, parceiro, áreas de suporte, operação).
  • Gerenciar riscos, resolver problemas utilizando ferramentas de gestão de projetos e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou afins.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e eventuais permanências em projeto.
  • Ampla vivência e experiência em gestão de projetos de médio/grande porte.
  • Pós-graduação em Gerenciamento de Projetos.
  • MS-Project Avançado.
  • Pacote office avançado (Principalmente Excel).

Desejável/Diferencial

  • Certificação Green Belt, PMI ou APM será diferencial.
  • Inglês intermediário será diferencial.

Local de Trabalho

  • Belo Horizonte/MG
  • Jornada Híbrida

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!

Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”

This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.

Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.

Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.

Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.

Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.

About the Role

As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.

Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.

What You’ll Gain

Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.
